factCards.text: Lehman Brothers filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy on 15 September 2008, the largest such filing in United States history.
factCards.sourceTitle: US Bankruptcy Court, Southern District of New York, case 08-13555

factCards.text: German hyperinflation peaked in late 1923; the Papiermark was replaced by the Rentenmark that November to stop the spiral.
Prices for rare tulip bulbs in the Dutch Republic rose sharply through 1636 and collapsed in February 1637, though historians disagree about how much wider economic damage followed.
factCards.sourceTitle: Anne Goldgar, Tulipmania (2007), which challenges the traditional account
